ClipChildren: Clips descendant rendering to this element's transformed bounds.
Color: Applies the element's ARGB color or vertex tint.
Material: Selects the material resource used to render this element.
Opacity: Sets local opacity from 0 (transparent) to 1 (opaque); parent opacity also applies.
Show: Controls whether this element and its descendants are shown.
Id: Identifies the element for timelines, navigation, references, and editor selection.
ClassOverride: Uses the named Chrome 6 or Dying Light class instead of the XML element name when resolving inherited properties.
Visual: References a reusable XuiVisual template; the editor composes this behavior approximately.
NavLeft: Names the element that receives focus when navigation moves left.
NavRight: Names the element that receives focus when navigation moves right.
NavUp: Names the element that receives focus when navigation moves up.
NavDown: Names the element that receives focus when navigation moves down.
NavTabForward: Names the element that receives focus when tab navigation moves forward.
NavTabBackward: Names the element that receives focus when tab navigation moves backward.
Width: Sets the element's local design width.
Height: Sets the element's local design height.
Position: Sets the element's local XYZ position relative to its parent.
Scale: Sets local XYZ scale around Pivot.
Pivot: Sets the unrestricted local-space XYZ origin used for scale and rotation.
HoldAspectRatio: Uses one uniform scale ratio for both axes when parent or resolution size changes.
HoldAspectRatioX: Uses the horizontal ratio, instead of the vertical ratio, when HoldAspectRatio chooses its uniform scale.
HoldAspectPivotPosition: Scales the pivot with the same uniform ratio used by HoldAspectRatio.
KeepWidth: Keeps the authored width when the parent size changes.
KeepWidthOnParentSizeChange: Keeps the authored width when the parent size changes.
KeepWidthOnResolutionChange: Keeps the authored width when preview resolution changes.
KeepHeight: Keeps the authored height when the parent size changes.
KeepHeightOnParentSizeChange: Keeps the authored height when the parent size changes.
KeepHeightOnResolutionChange: Keeps the authored height when preview resolution changes.
KeepPosX: Keeps the authored X position when the parent size changes.
KeepPosXOnParentSizeChange: Keeps the authored X position when the parent size changes.
KeepPosXOnResolutionChange: Keeps the authored X position when preview resolution changes.
KeepPosY: Keeps the authored Y position when the parent size changes.
KeepPosYOnParentSizeChange: Keeps the authored Y position when the parent size changes.
KeepPosYOnResolutionChange: Keeps the authored Y position when preview resolution changes.
ScaleWidthByResolution: Scales width by the preview resolution's horizontal factor.
Text: Sets literal text or a localization key resolved by the selected preview language.
Font: Selects the engine font ID or font resource used for text.
ImagePath: Selects the image or texture-region resource rendered by an image element.
TextStyle: Stores the packed Chrome 6 formatting and alignment bitmask; unknown compatibility bits are preserved.
Bold: Enables bold text and overrides the equivalent legacy TextStyle bit when authored.
Italic: Enables italic text and overrides the equivalent legacy TextStyle bit when authored.
Underline: Enables underlined text and overrides the equivalent legacy TextStyle bit when authored.
HorizontalAlign: Sets left, center, or right text alignment and overrides legacy TextStyle alignment when authored.
VerticalAlign: Sets top, middle, or bottom text alignment and overrides legacy TextStyle alignment when authored.
VerticalAlignDown: Enables Dying Light's legacy bottom-alignment behavior, separately from TextStyle.
MultiLine: Allows text to wrap and occupy multiple lines.
Uppercase: Transforms displayed text to uppercase using the preview language.
OutlineSize: Sets the thickness of the text outline.
ShadowOffset: Offsets the text shadow from the glyphs.
ColorControlSequenceEnabled: Enables inline %COLOR(...) control sequences in displayed text.
FontYOffset: Overrides the legacy TextStyle vertical font offset when authored.
SpecialSignsScale: Overrides legacy TextStyle scaling for special-sign glyphs when authored.
Strike: Enables standalone strike-through formatting when supported; the value is preserved for compatibility.
